sections.content: A raíz de and como consecuencia de both introduce a cause; en el marco de sets the broader situation something happened within. A paragraph explaining political instability typically needs all three: what caused it, what followed from it, and what larger context it occurred in. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A raíz de la falta de instituciones consolidadas, la inestabilidad política se convirtió en la norma.
items.english: As a result of the lack of consolidated institutions, political instability became the norm.

items.spanish: En el marco de esta inestabilidad surgió un término específico: el pronunciamiento.
items.english: Within the context of this instability, a specific term emerged: the pronunciamiento.

items.spanish: Bolivia, como consecuencia de esta dinámica, llegó a tener varias decenas de gobiernos distintos en pocas décadas.
items.english: Bolivia, as a consequence of this dynamic, came to have several dozen different governments in just a few decades.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia directa de esta rotación constante, resultaba prácticamente imposible sostener políticas de largo plazo.
items.english: As a direct consequence of this constant turnover, it was practically impossible to sustain long-term policies.

sections.content: When como consecuencia de appears twice in the same paragraph (as here), notice how the second one narrows the focus — the first names Bolivia's instability as a consequence of the broader dynamic, the second traces one specific effect of that instability (no long-term policy). Repetition of the connector is fine; it's the scope that should shift.
